assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner uses varied vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner some of the targeted vocabulary and expressions in oral interactions

assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner uses correct pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and articulation at all times in oral expression.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses appropriate pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and articulation in oral expression.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses fairly good pronunciation, intonation, rhythm and articulation in oral expression.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to respond to questions and prompts in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner responds to some questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.below: The learner responds to few questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to extract and interpret information from oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner appropriately extracts and interprets information from oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner satisfactorily extracts and interprets information from oral interactions
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner extracts and interprets information from oral interactions to some extent.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner extracts and interprets information from oral interactions with some difficulties.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to display willingness to participate in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is always willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner is at times hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions
assessment_rubric.below: The learner is mostly hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to respond correctly to questions on selected written texts.
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner responds correctly to all questions and goes further to give appropriate illustrations and examples.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner responds correctly to all questions and shows comprehension and engagement.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner responds to most of the questions to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.below: The learner responds to very few questions to show comprehension and engagement

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to display willingness to participate in reading different type of texts.
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is always willing to participate in reading different types of texts. Encourages others to engage in reading.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is always willing to participate in reading different types of texts.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner at times participates in reading different types of texts.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner is mostly hesitant to participate in reading different types of texts.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use correct punctuation and orthography to produce written texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner uses correct punctuation and orthography all the time to produce written texts
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses correct punctuation and orthography most of the time to produce written texts
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses correct punctuation and orthography very few times to produce written texts

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to maintain correct language structures (structure of words and sentences)
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner maintains accurate use of language structures all through; structure of words and sentences are correct all the time.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner maintains use of language structures making few errors; (structure of words and sentences) .
assessment_rubric.below: The learner maintains use of language structures making many errors; (structure of words and sentences)

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use correct vocabulary and expressions to write texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner appropriately uses a wide variety of vocabulary and expressions to write texts
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses a variety of vocabulary and expressions to write texts
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses vocabulary and expressions to write texts
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses limited vocabulary and expressions to write texts

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to write coherent sentences and texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner consistently writes coherent sentences and texts in a wide variety of contexts.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner consistently writes coherent sentences and texts
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner often writes coherent sentences and texts
assessment_rubric.below: The learner scarcely writes coherent sentences and texts

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to exhibit interest to produce written texts
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner always exhibits interest to produce varied written texts. Encourages others to engage in oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner exhibits interest to produce written texts.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner hesitates to exhibit interest to produce written texts.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner mostly hesitates to exhibit interest to produce written texts.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use grammar and syntax. Correct use of verb tenses, conjugations. Accurate sentence structure and word order. Proper use of the French articles
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner uses grammar and syntax well adhering to the correct use of verb tenses, conjugations, Ensures accurate sentence structure and proper use of French articles
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses grammar and syntax in a fairly good way however has challenges with the correct use of verb tenses conjugations, accurate sentence and word order and does not use the French articles accurately
assessment_rubric.below: The learner has extremely minimal mastery of grammar and syntax. Does not use the verb tenses correctly. Confuses the sentence structure and word order. Literally confuses the French articles .

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use a large of vocabulary and idiomatic expressions and spelling accuracy, .
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner display competence at using a large range of vocabulary and idiomatic expressions and spelling accuracy.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use Coherence and Cohesion in grammatical structures. Logical flow and organization of ideas.
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner displays coherence and cohesion in grammatical structures and logical flow and organization of ideas with relative ease.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner displays coherence and cohesion in grammatical and logical flow and organization of ideas some challenges .
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner displays coherence and cohesion in grammatical and logical flow of ideas with quite a number of errors.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner displays coherence and cohesion in grammatical and logical flow of ideas with too many errors.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use content and creativity well based on a given topic applying relevant grammatical structures.
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner uses content and creativity well based on a given topic applying relevant grammatical structures extremely well.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner uses content and creativity based on a given topic applying relevant grammatical structures with extremely minimal errors.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses content and creativity based on a given topic applying relevant grammatical structures with quite a number of errors.
assessment_rubric.below: The leaner uses content and creativity based on a given topic applying grammatical structures with excessive errors.

substrands.name: Reading for vocabulary

inquiry_questions: Why confidence vital in interactive speaking?
